lines.beaver: 민지야, 토론 대회 결과 나왔어? 어떻게 됐어?
lines.beaver_en: Minji, are the debate contest results out? How did it go?
lines.beaver_roman: Minjiya, toron daehoe gyeolgwa nawasseo? Eotteoke dwaesseo?
lines.en: Yeah, they're out! I got first place!
I'm telling you, it's true. I still can't believe it.
Yeah, everyone's jealous. I'm so happy!

lines.beaver_en: Are you happy with the result?
lines.en: Yes, I'm really satisfied. It's the best!

lines.beaver_en: You were so nervous before the contest.
lines.en: Right, I'm telling you, I was super nervous.

lines.learner: 중간에 단어가 생각 안 나서 당황했어.
lines.en: I forgot a word in the middle and got flustered.
lines.roman: Junggane daneoga saenggak an naseo danghwanghaesseo.

lines.en: Yeah, I'm telling you, I was so disappointed then.

lines.beaver_en: You must have felt relieved hearing the result.

lines.learner: 시간 관리를 잘 못한 게 좀 아쉬워.
lines.en: I'm a bit sorry I didn't manage my time well.
lines.roman: Sigan gwallireul jal motan ge jom aswiwo.

lines.beaver_en: Still, that's amazing! Let's celebrate today!
lines.learner: 좋아! 오늘은 내가 맛있는 거 살게.
lines.en: Sounds good! I'll treat you to something tasty today.
lines.roman: Joa! Oneureun naega masinneun geo salge.
